examples.text: Casi me da un ataque cardíaco.
examples.en: I almost had a heart attack.

examples.text: ¿Alguna vez has sufrido un ataque cardíaco?
examples.en: Have you ever had a heart attack?
He had suffered a heart attack.

examples.text: Él ha sobrevivido a tres paros cardíacos.
examples.en: He has lived through three heart attacks.

examples.text: Las siguientes imágenes no son aptas para cardíacos.
examples.en: The following images are not for the faint of heart.
